summary: Native Android release 0.5.19 (versionCode 21): the first Play build. Ships everything merged since 0.5.18: the foreground reconnect fix (#362: resume probe and redial, 15 s pings, default-network callback, stale handshake timers ignored, leased listeners follow redials), machine rows with transport state (#358), release cleartext limited to loopback (#361) and the revoked-phone message (#363). Replaces the 0.5.18 internal draft on Play.
